extensionDescription.message: Radial New Tab is a calm, adaptive Microsoft Edge new tab that places your favorite websites around a personal clock and search. Add, edit, reorder, import, and export shortcuts; organize them into optional collections; import a selected Edge bookmarks folder with nested collections; and optionally add sites from Edge's top sites list after permission. Choose your preferred search provider, use orbit or smart-tile layouts, switch light and dark themes, and use focus mode, keyboard navigation, and a local background image. Your links and settings stay in Edge storage, with no analytics or Radial servers.
